ADR 0038 and ADR 0004: typed owner-thread full-text replacement uses the focused LineEdit/TextEdit/CodeEdit Text setter. Embedded-window focus forwards recursively, native windows and direct SubViewports keep independent GUI focus, and a focused SubViewportContainer does not forward. Paused, read-only and GUI-input-disabled editors remain authorable. Null/disposed/off-owner/capture guards execute. TextChanged and Control.TextInput are suppressed; multiline TextSet is synchronous even for equal assignments, replacement preserves undo, and queued real user changes survive. ViewportTextInputTests covers routing, scalar limits, history, failures and current native renderer integration.
